title: Enterprise Supply Chain Demand Forecasting: Chronos/TimesFM + LightGBM, LLM Covariate Featurizer & Conformal Safety-Stock Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Prompting Text LLMs (GPT-4o/Claude) Directly with CSV Sales History
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: BPE tokenizers butcher numerical series (28.4% WAPE, $85K/mo tokens, $640K/mo TCO)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Legacy Univariate ARIMA / ETS Per-SKU Statistical Forecasting
tiers.verdict: Blind to cold-start SKU launches, cross-SKU cannibalization, and unstructured promo briefs

tiers.name: Tier 3: Point-Forecast LightGBM Only (No TSFM Cold-Start or P95 Quantile Safety Stock)
tiers.verdict: Point-only averages miss lead-time spikes (4.8% stockout) & fail on <8-week cold-start SKUs

tiers.name: Tier 4: LightGBM + Chronos/TimesFM Cold-Start + LLM Covariate Extractor + P95 Conformal + OR-Tools
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 9.4% WAPE, 12.8% cold-start WAPE, 1.1% stockout rate & -89.4% TCO ($68K/mo)
